description: Awin fall-back conversion image and S2S reads on www.awin1.com/sread.img and /sread.php, including product-level bd[n] rows and custom pN keys. Product-level basket.php requests are vendor/awin-basket. The MasterTag on www.dwin1.com is vendor/awin-mastertag.

params.name: merchant
params.description: It is the numeric Awin advertiser ID. The published pixel template requires it.
params.fix_hint: Set `merchant` to the Advertiser ID from the Awin UI.

params.name: tt
params.description: It is the tracking type. The image pixel sends `ns`; server-to-server sends `ss`.
params.fix_hint: Use `tt=ns` on the image pixel and `tt=ss` on the S2S read.

params.name: tv
params.description: It is the tracking version. The published template sends `tv=2`.

params.name: amount
params.description: It is the sale subtotal after discounts, excluding tax and shipping. Awin documents a float with a dot decimal and no thousands separator.
params.fix_hint: Set `amount` to the order subtotal, such as `1083.29`.

params.name: ch
params.description: It names the last-click channel. Awin documents `aw` for Awin traffic.
params.fix_hint: Set `ch=aw` for Awin last-click, or the documented channel for that conversion.

params.name: parts
params.description: It is the commission group code plus amount, such as `DEFAULT:8.33`. Multiple groups are pipe-delimited, such as `CD:11.10|DVD:14.99`. Awin documents `{group}:{amount}` as required.
params.fix_hint: Set `parts` to `{group}:{amount}`, using `DEFAULT` when no group is configured.

params.name: ref
params.description: It is the unique order reference. Awin documents it as required and unique per conversion.
params.fix_hint: Set `ref` to a unique, URL-encoded order identifier.

params.name: cr
params.description: It is the ISO 4217 currency code. The published template includes it.
params.fix_hint: Set `cr` to a three-letter currency code such as `GBP`.

params.name: testmode
params.description: Awin documents `0` for live conversions and `1` to skip processing.

params.name: vc
params.description: It is the voucher code when a discount was used. Awin documents returning the pair even when the value is empty.

params.name: cks
params.description: It is the Awin click identifier (`awc`) on server-to-server reads. Awin documents it as required when `tt=ss`.
params.fix_hint: Replay the stored `awc` value as `cks` on `/sread.php`.

params.name: customeracquisition
params.description: It names the customer type. Awin documents `NEW` or `RETURNING` on the fall-back pixel.

params.name: bd[0]
params.description: It is one product-level tracking row on the fall-back pixel or S2S read. Awin documents `bd[n]` as `AW:P|{advertiserId}|{orderReference}|{productId}|{productName}|{productItemPrice}|{productQuantity}|{productSku}|{commissionGroupCode}|{productCategory}`. Price is a float with a dot decimal. Quantity is a positive integer. SKU and category may be blank.

params.name: p1
params.description: It is a custom parameter on the fall-back pixel. Awin documents `p1` through `pN` as URL-encoded GET keys.
params.fix_hint: URL-encode the custom value, or drop the empty pair.

rules.message: A server-to-server read has no `cks`. Awin documents the Awin click checksum as required when `tt=ss`.
